entry.title: Robocon ORC National Finals 2025–2026 draws nearly 200 teams
entry.summary: The Robocon ORC National Finals 2025–2026 wrapped up on June 6–7, 2026 at the
entry.content:
The Robocon ORC National Finals 2025–2026 wrapped up on June 6–7, 2026 at the Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology and Education, bringing together nearly 200 teams from more than 100 schools across Vietnam — a highlight of the country's growing STEM robotics community.

At a glance​

  • When: June 6–7, 2026
  • Where: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology and Education
  • Scale: ~200 teams from 100+ schools nationwide, from primary school through university
  • Format: multiple divisions by age/experience; teams were judged on robot assembly and programming, tactics, on-the-spot problem solving, and teamwork
  • Season: the finals capped a year-long path of online rounds and regional tournaments

The event was organized by the Institute for School Design Research (under the Ministry of Education and Training), co-hosted with Phan Thiet University, and sponsored by OhStem Education — one of ACLAB's partners in STEM and robotics competitions — together with Lidinco.

Why we're sharing this

ACLAB works with OhStem on hands-on robotics and competition activities. Events like this grow the talent pipeline we love to see join the lab. Interested in building competition robots? Join ACLAB.

Source: orc.vn

entry.title: Seminar: Edge AI for real-time visual inspection
entry.summary: This month's lab seminar covers deploying quantized vision models on embedded
entry.content:
This month's lab seminar covers deploying quantized vision models on embedded accelerators for real-time quality control on the factory floor.

Topics​

  • Model quantization and pruning for edge devices
  • Running inference on Jetson with TensorRT
  • Measuring latency, throughput and power on-device
  • A walkthrough of our visual-inspection project pipeline

The session is open to all lab members and interested students. Slides and demo code will be shared in the Knowledge Base afterwards.

entry.title: ACLAB team reaches national robotics competition finals
entry.summary: Our autonomous AGV team reached the finals of a national robotics competition
entry.content:
Our autonomous AGV team reached the finals of a national robotics competition with a LiDAR-based navigation stack designed and built entirely in the lab.

Highlights​

  • Differential-drive AGV with custom motor-driver PCBs
  • LiDAR SLAM and ROS 2 navigation
  • Real-time obstacle avoidance and path planning

Congratulations to the team! The platform continues as one of our active projects. Want to build the next one? Join ACLAB.
